data.istio-overview.json:
{
  "title": "Istio - Service Mesh",
  "uid": "istio-service-mesh-lab",
  "schemaVersion": 39,
  "version": 1,
  "refresh": "30s",
  "time": {"from":"now-1h","to":"now"},
  "panels": [
    {
      "id":1,
      "title":"Request Rate",
      "type":"timeseries",
      "gridPos":{"x":0,"y":0,"w":12,"h":8},
      "targets":[{"expr":"sum by (destination_service_name) (rate(istio_requests_total[5m]))","legendFormat":"{{destination_service_name}}"}]
    },
    {
      "id":2,
      "title":"HTTP 5xx Rate",
      "type":"timeseries",
      "gridPos":{"x":12,"y":0,"w":12,"h":8},
      "targets":[{"expr":"sum by (destination_service_name) (rate(istio_requests_total{response_code=~\"5..\"}[5m]))","legendFormat":"{{destination_service_name}}"}]
    },
    {
      "id":3,
      "title":"Request Duration P95",
      "type":"timeseries",
      "gridPos":{"x":0,"y":8,"w":24,"h":8},
      "targets":[{"expr":"histogram_quantile(0.95, sum by (le,destination_service_name) (rate(istio_request_duration_milliseconds_bucket[5m])))","legendFormat":"{{destination_service_name}}"}]
    }
  ]
}
